environment.description: Ktor microservice running on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (10.0.8.0/24) with NO NAT gateway and NO internet gateway attached to the route table. A com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint is attached with a custom endpoint policy that restricts PutObject to only the principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/order-processor-role AND only to the specific resource arn:aws:s3:::order-processing-prod/processed-orders/*. The subnet's route table has only local (10.0.0.0/16) and the S3 prefix list (pl-63a5400a) entries. Security group egress allows only port 443 to the S3 prefix list. No other VPC endpoints exist. DNS resolution uses Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint with no forwarding rules for external domains.

config.network: Private subnet, no NAT, no IGW on route table
config.dns: Route 53 Resolver, no forwarding rules, private hosted zones only
